description: Agent skill and setup guides for connecting AI agents to the public, read-only ysskrishna MCP server at https://www.ysskrishna.space/mcp, which exposes search and fetch tools for the site's products, blog posts and tools.
rules: The endpoint is https://www.ysskrishna.space/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no API key); it exposes two read-only tools, search and fetch.
search filters tags by exact lowercase kebab-case ids such as markdown-and-docs; display names such as Markdown do not match.
fetch only accepts an id returned by search: product:<number>, blog:<slug> or tool:<slug>; a URL or bare slug is not an id.
